title: Integrated wastewater and clinical genomic surveillance for high-resolution tracking of measles virus evolution and transmission.
abstract: Abstract Measles outbreaks have surged globally, challenging surveillance and control efforts. In South Africa, the 2024−2025 measles outbreak led to nearly 4,000 reported cases, triggering a nationwide vaccination campaign. However, tracking measles virus (MeV; species Morbillivirus hominis ) transmission and evolution remains difficult at scale, particularly in settings with limited access to care, diagnostic testing and sequencing capacity. Wastewater can enable population-scale virus surveillance, but low MeV concentrations limit detection sensitivity and sequencing quality. Here we show that overcoming these technical challenges enables integrated wastewater and clinical genomic surveillance that expands the coverage and resolution of MeV monitoring. We developed a virus concentration and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) workflow and applied it to 4,502 wastewater samples collected across all nine provinces of South Africa during the 2024−2025 outbreak. Wastewater MeV genotype prevalence tracked clinical estimates, and phylogenetic analyses combining wastewater and clinical sequences revealed geographically structured transmission and previously undetected inter-provincial spread. WGS recovered transmission links not captured by the field standard approach, which targets a 450-nucleotide region of the nucleoprotein gene (N450), highlighting the importance of WGS to accurately characterize transmission dynamics. Our study provides a cost-effective and scalable genomic surveillance approach to support measles control and elimination.

abstract_zh: 摘要 麻疹 暴发 在全球范围内激增,对 监测 和控制力度提出了挑战。在南非,2024−2025 年 麻疹 暴发 导致报告了近 4,000 起病例,引发了全国范围内的 疫苗接种 运动。然而,大规模追踪 麻疹病毒(MeV;人麻疹病毒属)传播 和 进化 仍然很困难,特别是在护理、诊断测试和测序能力有限的环境中。废水可以产生群体规模的病毒 监测,但低 MeV 浓度限制了检测灵敏度和测序质量。在这里,我们表明,克服这些技术挑战可以实现废水和临床综合 基因组监测,从而扩大 MeV 监测的覆盖范围和分辨率。我们开发了病毒浓缩和全 基因组 测序 (WGS) 工作流程,并将其应用于 2024 年至 2025 年 基因组 期间在南非所有九个省收集的 4,502 个废水样本。废水 MeV 基因型 患病率 跟踪了临床估计,结合废水和临床序列的系统发育分析揭示了 传播 的地理结构和以前未检测到的省际传播。WGS 恢复了现场标准方法未捕获的 传播 链接,该方法针对核蛋白基因 (N450) 的 450 个核苷酸区域,突出了 WGS 对于准确表征 传播 动力学的重要性。我们的研究提供了一种经济高效且可扩展的 基因组监测 方法来支持 麻疹 的控制和消除。

title: North America's measles reversal: Canada has lost elimination status, and the United States is next.
abstract: The region of the Americas achieved measles elimination in 2016, reflecting sustained vaccination coverage and strong surveillance systems. However, North America is now experiencing a marked resurgence. Canada formally lost measles elimination status on November 10, 2025, following more than 12 months of continuous transmission, and the United States is projected to lose its status in November 2026. Epidemiologic trends underscore the magnitude of reversal. Canada reported 5461 measles cases in 2025 and 1121 additional cases in 2026 (as of October 3), compared with only 146 cases in 2024. In the United States, 2288 cases and 48 outbreaks were documented in 2025 and 4410 additional cases in 2026 (as of October 15), up from only 285 cases and 16 outbreaks in 2024. Notably, 90% of US cases were outbreak-associated in 2025, 93% occurred among unvaccinated or unknown-status individuals, 11% required hospitalization, and three deaths in 2025 were recorded - the first in a decade. Regional data from the Pan American Health Organization documented 14,503 cases and 32 deaths across the Americas in 2025, with 55,792 cases and 77 deaths in 2026 (as of October 3). Declining vaccination coverage is central to this resurgence, with US kindergarten measles-mumps-rubella coverage falling to 92.5%, below the 95% threshold estimated to support measles population immunity. Contributing factors include expansion of nonmedical exemptions, weak enforcement of school-entry requirements, fragmented immunization infrastructures, underfunded public health systems, and increasing vaccine hesitancy amplified by misinformation. Restoring elimination status will require coordinated policy and programmatic action, including strengthening vaccination mandates, improving surveillance and immunization registries, enhancing community engagement, and rebuilding public trust in vaccines. Failure to act risks sustained transmission, preventable morbidity, and mortality, particularly in children in the Americas.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 美洲地区于 2016 年实现了 麻疹 消除,反映出持续的 疫苗接种 覆盖和强大的 监测 系统。然而,北美现在正在经历明显的复苏。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在连续超过 12 个月的 传播 后,加拿大于 2025 年 11 月 10 日正式失去 麻疹 消除地位,美国预计将于 2026 年 11 月失去其地位。
elements_zh.methods: 流行病学趋势凸显了逆转的严重程度。泛美卫生组织的区域数据显示,2025 年美洲地区有 14,503 例病例和 32 例死亡,2026 年有 55,792 例病例和 77 例死亡(截至 10 月 3 日)。
elements_zh.main_results: 加拿大报告 2025 年报告了 5461 例 麻疹 病例,2026 年报告了 1121 例新增病例(截至 10 月 3 日),而 2024 年仅记录了 146 例。在美国,2025 年记录了 2288 例和 48 例 麻疹 病例,2026 年新增了 4410 例(截至 10 月 15 日),而 2024 年仅记录了 2288 例和 48 例 麻疹 病例,2026 年新增了 4410 例(截至 10 月 15 日)。2024 年将有 285 起案件和 16 起 暴发。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 麻疹 覆盖率下降是这种复苏的核心,美国幼儿园 麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹覆盖率下降至 92.5%,低于估计支持 麻疹 人群免疫力的 95% 阈值。促成因素包括扩大非医疗豁免、入学要求执行不力、免疫基础设施分散、公共卫生系统资金不足,以及因错误信息而加剧的 疫苗 犹豫不决。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 恢复消除状态需要协调一致的政策和计划行动,包括加强 疫苗接种 的授权、改进 监测 和免疫登记、增强社区参与以及重建公众对 疫苗 的信任。不采取行动会带来持续的 传播、可预防的发病率和 死亡率,特别是对于美洲的儿童。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 值得注意的是,到 2025 年,美国 90% 的病例与 暴发 相关,93% 发生在未接种疫苗或状况不明的个体中,11% 需要住院治疗,2025 年记录了 3 例死亡——这是十年来的首次。提供的证据未报告具体的统计分析或置信区间。

title: Preliminary safety observations following measles-mumps-rubella vaccination in natalizumab-treated patients with multiple sclerosis: a case series in the context of rising measles incidence in Italy.
abstract: BACKGROUND: In Natalizumab (NTZ)-treated patients, only inactivated vaccines are proven safe; live vaccines require caution. Italy shows a measles resurgence, mainly in unvaccinated people with notable complications. Vaccine coverage is insufficient. OBJECTIVES: Given rising risk, our multiple sclerosis Disease Management Team endorsed measles vaccination during NTZ therapy for susceptible patients, consistent with prior selective VZV vaccination. RESULTS: To date, 11 patients have been vaccinated with the Measles-Mumps-Rubella (MMR) vaccine during NTZ treatment at our centre. In three cases, co-administration with the VZV vaccine was necessary. None of the patients who received the vaccine developed vaccine-associated adverse reactions or VZV infection. CONCLUSIONS: Management of MS requires an integrated approach that balances immunosuppressive treatment risks with preventive strategies, such as vaccination, to reduce infection risk while ensuring patient safety. Larger patient cohorts are needed to confirm our preliminary findings.
authors: Multiple Sclerosis Disease Management Team (MS DMT)

title: Measles in adults: emergency department identification and management.
abstract: Increasing numbers of measles outbreaks in the United States have renewed the need for rapid recognition and management in emergency departments. Although adult presentations vary, emergency clinicians must recognize the classic prodrome and identify patients at risk for severe disease. Prompt airborne precautions, appropriate diagnostic testing, and timely postexposure prophylaxis are essential to limit healthcare-associated and community transmission. This review summarizes the clinical features, diagnosis, complications, and evidence-based management of measles in adults in the emergency department.

title: Measles and rubella IgM positivity and case classification accuracy in Mozambique's national case-based surveillance system, 2016–2021
abstract: Abstract Introduction: Mozambique adopted case-based surveillance for measles and rubella in 2016. This study aimed to characterise clinically suspected cases and assess serological and epidemiological data quality. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional study using data from the national surveillance system, 2016–2021. Per national protocol, all clinically suspected cases (fever and generalised rash) are tested for measles and rubella IgM. Analyses used cases with valid (adequate specimen and clear result) measles IgM results (n = 12,674), rubella IgM results (n = 12,177), or both (n = 12,143). Multivariable logistic regression identified factors associated with IgM positivity. Results Of 15,782 suspected cases, 12,708 (81%) had at least one valid IgM result (12,674 for measles and 12,177 for rubella). Among those tested for both (n = 12,143), IgM was positive for measles in 1,581 (13%), for rubella in 993 (8.2%), and for both in 424 (3.5%). Among those with any IgM result (n = 12,708), 4,368 (34%) had specimens collected in the optimal collection window (4–28 days for measles; 6–28 days for rubella) after rash onset, and 597 (4.8%) had received measles-containing vaccine ≤ 28 days before sample collection. Among confirmed measles cases (n = 1,697), 424 (25%) were also rubella IgM-positive; among confirmed rubella cases (n = 996), 424 (43%) were also measles IgM-positive. All provinces consistently reported cases and submitted samples. Positivity was higher in the northern and central regions versus the southern region, among those vaccinated 8–28 days before sample collection, and among those sampled in the optimal window versus ≤ 3 days after rash onset (measles: 16% vs 12%; adjusted odds ratio [AOR] = 1.2 [1.0–1.3]). Conclusion The high proportion of co-positive cases, together with elevated IgM positivity among recently vaccinated individuals, may reflect vaccine-induced IgM or cross-reactive serology. IgM serology alone is insufficient for accurate case classification without integration of vaccination history and epidemiological context. Surveillance systems that achieve higher completeness of documentation, appropriate sample timing, and consistent application of classification criteria are better positioned to generate accurate incidence estimates and detect outbreaks promptly.

abstract_zh: 摘要简介:莫桑比克于2016年针对麻疹和风疹采用了基于病例的监测。本研究旨在描述临床疑似病例的特征并评估血清学和流行病学数据的质量。方法 我们使用 2016-2021 年国家 监测 系统的数据进行了一项横断面研究。根据国家方案,所有临床疑似病例(发烧和全身皮疹)均需接受 麻疹 和风疹 IgM 检测。分析具有有效(充足样本和明确结果)麻疹 IgM 结果 (n = 12,674)、风疹 IgM 结果 (n = 12,177) 或两者 (n = 12,143) 的已用病例。多变量逻辑回归确定了与 IgM 阳性相关的因素。结果 在 15,782 例疑似病例中,12,708 例(81%)至少有一项有效 IgM 结果(麻疹 为 12,674 例,风疹为 12,177 例)。在接受这两种检测的人中 (n = 12,143),麻疹 IgM 呈阳性的人数为 1,581 人 (13%),风疹 IgM 呈阳性的人数为 993 人 (8.2%),两者均呈阳性的人数为 424 人 (3.5%)。在具有任何 IgM 结果的患者中 (n = 12,708),4,368 例 (34%) 在皮疹发病后的最佳采集窗口(麻疹 为 4-28 天;风疹为 6-28 天)采集了标本,597 例 (4.8%) 在样本采集前 28 天以内接受了含有 麻疹 的 疫苗。在确诊的 麻疹 病例 (n = 1,697) 中,有 424 例 (25%) 风疹 IgM 呈阳性;在确诊的风疹病例 (n = 996) 中,424 例 (43%) 也为 麻疹 IgM 阳性。各省份均一致报告病例并提交样本。北部和中部地区的阳性率高于南部地区,在样本采集前 8-28 天接种疫苗的人群中,以及在最佳窗口内采样的人群中,与皮疹发病后 ≤ 3 天以内采样的人群中,阳性率较高(麻疹:16% vs 12%;调整后的比值比 [AOR] = 1.2 [1.0-1.3])。结论 近期接种疫苗的个体中,高比例的共阳性病例以及 IgM 阳性率升高,可能反映了 疫苗 诱导的 IgM 或交叉反应性 血清学。如果不整合 疫苗接种 病史和流行病学背景,仅 IgM 血清学 不足以进行准确的病例分类。监测 系统实现了更高的文档完整性、适当的采样时间和一致的分类标准应用,可以更好地生成准确的 发病率 估计值并及时检测 暴发。

title: Diffusion Tensor Imaging in Patients with Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis: a Prospective Follow-up Study.
abstract: PURPOSE: Conventional MRI may underestimate disease burden in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE). Clinical disease stage and conventional neuroimaging often do not correlate. We evaluated diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) abnormalities across clinical stages and their longitudinal changes over six months. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate DTI abnormalities across clinical stages of SSPE and assess longitudinal changes in fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) over six months. METHODS: In this prospective study, 41 patients with SSPE (Stage II: n = 15; Stage III: n = 26) and 15 age-matched healthy controls underwent MRI with DTI. We measured fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) across multiple predefined brain regions and tracts. Differences in FA and MD values across groups were assessed using the Kruskal-Wallis test, followed by pairwise Mann-Whitney U tests for between-group comparisons. For pairwise comparisons, the magnitude of between-group differences was expressed as the mean difference with corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Longitudinal changes in FA and MD values from baseline to the 6‐month follow-up within the same patients were assessed using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test. To account for multiple comparisons across the predefined brain regions and white matter tracts, p-values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) procedure, and FDR-adjusted q‐values were reported. A two-sided p-value or FDR-adjusted q‐value < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. RESULTS: SSPE patients demonstrated reduced FA and increased MD compared with healthy controls, with more extensive abnormalities in Stage III disease. DTI abnormalities were detected even in patients with normal conventional MRI. At six months, FA decreased and MD increased in most examined regions, indicating progressive loss of white-matter integrity despite treatment. In intraindividual analysis, the splenium of the corpus callosum demonstrated relatively consistent FA reduction and MD increase, whereas the occipital and parietal white matter showed greater interindividual heterogeneity despite significant group-level changes. CONCLUSION: DTI demonstrates progressive white-matter abnormalities in SSPE that may not be fully captured by conventional MRI. The relatively consistent longitudinal FA and MD changes in the splenium of the corpus callosum suggest that it may serve as an imaging biomarker for monitoring disease progression; however, its validation in larger longitudinal cohorts is needed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 传统 MRI 可能低估 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE) 的疾病负担。临床疾病阶段和常规神经影像学通常不相关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项前瞻性研究中,41 名 SSPE 患者(II 期:n = 15;III 期:n = 26)和 15 名年龄匹配的健康对照接受了弥散张量成像 (DTI) MRI。
elements_zh.methods: 我们测量了多个预定义大脑区域和束的分数各向异性 (FA) 和平均扩散率 (MD)。使用 Kruskal-Wallis 检验评估各组 FA 和 MD 值的差异,然后使用成对 Mann-Whitney U 检验进行组间比较。对于成对比较,组间差异的大小表示为具有相应 95% 置信区间 (CI) 的平均差异。使用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验评估同一患者 FA 和 MD 值从基线到 6 个月随访的纵向变化。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: DTI 显示 SSPE 中进行性白质异常,传统 MRI 可能无法完全捕获这些异常。胼胝体压部相对一致的纵向 FA 和 MD 变化表明它可以作为监测疾病进展的成像生物标志物。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,弥散张量成像 (DTI) 可以改善 SSPE 中白质异常的检测,而传统 MRI 可能无法完全捕获这种异常。这可以为 监测 和疾病进展监测提供更准确的信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量相对较小和使用单一中心的限制。该证据是中等的,因为它基于一项前瞻性随访研究和统计分析。

analysis_zh.methods: 我们测量了多个预定义大脑区域和束的分数各向异性 (FA) 和平均扩散率 (MD)。使用 Kruskal-Wallis 检验评估各组 FA 和 MD 值的差异,然后使用成对 Mann-Whitney U 检验进行组间比较。对于成对比较,组间差异的大小表示为具有相应 95% 置信区间 (CI) 的平均差异。使用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验评估同一患者 FA 和 MD 值从基线到 6 个月随访的纵向变化。
analysis_zh.main_results: 与健康对照相比,SSPE 患者的 FA 减少,MD 增加,III 期疾病出现更广泛的异常。即使在常规 MRI 正常的患者中也能检测到 DTI 异常。六个月时,大多数检查区域的 FA 下降,MD 增加,表明尽管存在 治疗,但白质完整性逐渐丧失。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: DTI 显示 SSPE 中进行性白质异常,传统 MRI 可能无法完全捕获这些异常。胼胝体压部相对一致的纵向 FA 和 MD 变化表明它可以作为监测疾病进展的成像生物标志物。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,弥散张量成像 (DTI) 可以改善 SSPE 中白质异常的检测,而传统 MRI 可能无法完全捕获这种异常。这可以为 监测 和疾病进展监测提供更准确的信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量相对较小和使用单一中心的限制。该证据是中等的,因为它基于一项前瞻性随访研究和统计分析。

title: Kindergarten measles vaccination coverage and the 2025–2026 measles resurgence in the United States: a state-level analysis of public surveillance data
abstract: Abstract Background In November 2026, the United States lost the measles elimination status it had held since 2000. This study examined whether states with lower kindergarten measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccination coverage had more measles during the 2025–2026 resurgence, and how coverage changed before, during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods In this ecological study, kindergarten MMR coverage and non-medical exemptions (CDC SchoolVaxView, 2009–10 to 2025–26) were combined with state and county measles case counts, census population estimates and national data for Canada and Mexico. Associations were assessed with Spearman correlation and negative binomial regression. Results National coverage fell from 95.2% in 2019–20 to 92.4% in 2025–26, and non-medical exemptions rose from 2.2% to 4.0%. Coverage dropped in most states during the pandemic and did not recover afterward. Measles cases averaged 410 per year before the pandemic, 61 during it and 2,011 after it. Each 1-percentage-point decrease in coverage was associated with 15% more cases (incidence rate ratio 1.15, 95% CI 1.01–1.31), although the association was sensitive to the exclusion of single states and coverage did not predict large outbreaks. Of 8,025 cases with county data, 96.8% were locally acquired, and half occurred in 18 counties or health regions. Conclusions Kindergarten MMR coverage fell during the pandemic and has not recovered. States with lower coverage had more measles, and cases were concentrated in a few counties. Restoring coverage above 95% is needed to re-establish elimination.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to determine if lower kindergarten MMR vaccination coverage in states was associated with more measles cases during the 2025–2026 resurgence, following the loss of measles elimination status in 2026.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An ecological study was conducted using kindergarten MMR coverage and non-medical exemptions data from 2009–10 to 2025–26, combined with state and county measles case counts, census population estimates, and national data from Canada and Mexico.
analysis.methods: Associations were assessed using Spearman correlation and negative binomial regression, with data on MMR coverage and non-medical exemptions, measles cases, and population estimates.
analysis.main_results: National MMR coverage fell from 95.2% in 2019–20 to 92.4% in 2025–26, and non-medical exemptions increased from 2.2% to 4.0%. Each 1-percentage-point decrease in coverage was associated with a 15% increase in cases (incidence rate ratio 1.15, 95% CI 1.01–1.31).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that lower MMR coverage was associated with more measles cases, and that coverage did not predict large outbreaks. The findings suggest that restoring coverage above 95% is necessary to re-establish measles elimination.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies to improve vaccination coverage and prevent future measles outbreaks, particularly in states with lower coverage.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the ecological design, which cannot establish causality, and by the sensitivity of the association to the exclusion of single states. The evidence strength is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study examined the association between kindergarten MMR vaccination coverage and measles cases during the 2025–2026 resurgence in the United States. Lower coverage was linked to more measles cases, and restoring coverage above 95% is needed to re-establish measles elimination.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,较低的 MMR 覆盖率与更多的 麻疹 病例相关,并且该覆盖率并不能预测较大的 麻疹 病例。研究结果表明,要重新消除 麻疹,必须将覆盖率恢复到 95% 以上。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为公共卫生策略提供信息,以提高 疫苗接种 覆盖率并预防未来的 麻疹 暴发,特别是在覆盖率较低的州。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到生态设计的限制,无法建立因果关系,并且受到关联对排除单一状态的敏感性的限制。由于这些限制,证据强度中等。

title: KINDERGARTEN NONMEDICAL EXEMPTIONS AND CLUSTERED MEASLES CASES ACROSS US COUNTIES DURING THE 2025 RESURGENCE
abstract: Background: The 2025 US measles resurgence was concentrated in communities with low vaccination coverage. Aggregate national and state measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) coverage can mask local susceptibility: pockets of unvaccinated children persist where average coverage appears adequate. School-entry nonmedical exemptions (NMEs) are collected routinely and may capture vaccination behavior and clustering of susceptible children. We examined whether county-level kindergarten NME rates were associated with reporting at least 3 measles cases in 2025, independently of average county MMR coverage. Methods: Cross-sectional ecological study of US counties. Confirmed cases reported January 1 to December 31, 2025, came from the Johns Hopkins University US Measles Tracker. Kindergarten MMR coverage and NME rates (school year 2023-2024 or, if unavailable, 2022- 2023) came from public state reports and published county-level compilations. The prespecified outbreak proxy was 3 or more versus 0-2 reported cases per county, a count threshold without verified epidemiologic linkage. A secondary, exploratory outcome was total case burden among counties with 3 or more cases. Firth penalized logistic regression estimated odds ratios (ORs) for occurrence; negative binomial regression with a log county-population offset and state-clustered robust standard errors estimated incidence rate ratios (IRRs) for burden. Models adjusted for percentage foreign-born, metropolitan status, population density, percentage uninsured, college education, 2024 presidential vote share, and primary care physician supply; estimates are per 1-percentage-point increase. Sensitivity analyses varied the threshold and adjustment set and examined spatial dependence, international airport proximity, state exclusions, and modified Poisson estimation. Only aggregate, publicly available data were analyzed; the study was exempt from institutional review. Results: The sample comprised 1914 counties in 30 states (237 million residents, 71.6% of the US population), capturing 1821 of 2214 reported 2025 cases (82.2%); 66 counties (3.4%) met the outbreak proxy. Mean (SD) MMR coverage was 91.1% (7.2%) and mean NME rate 4.58% (4.37%). In the joint model, each 1-percentage-point higher NME rate was associated with higher odds of meeting the proxy (OR 1.16; 95% CI 1.09-1.24; P<.001), whereas average MMR coverage was not (OR 1.01; 95% CI 0.96 1.07; P=.78). The exemption association persisted across thresholds of 1 to 10 or more cases (ORs 1.12-1.17), with reduced adjustment (OR 1.15), airport-proximity adjustment (OR 1.16), and modified Poisson estimation (risk ratio 1.14; 95% CI 1.06-1.23). Residual spatial autocorrelation was present (Moran I 0.0758; P=.001), and adding neighboring counties' exemption rates attenuated the OR to 1.12 (95% CI 1.03-1.20). In the exploratory burden model, the IRR was 1.08 (95% CI 1.00-1.16; P=.046), with confidence intervals crossing the null in several specifications. Conclusions: Across US counties in 2025, kindergarten nonmedical exemption rates were associated with clustered measles case reports independently of average MMR coverage, which carried little additional information once exemptions were considered. Estimates are ecological, not individual-level or causal; the count proxy did not establish epidemiologic linkage, and exposure definitions varied across states. Routinely collected school-entry exemption data may nonetheless complement local knowledge when pediatricians, school health programs, and health departments prioritize school-level review and outbreak preparedness.

title_zh: KINDERGARTEN NONMEDICAL EXEMPTIONS AND CLUSTERED MEASLES CASES ACROSS US COUNTIES DURING THE 2025 RESURGENCE
source_body_en: Background: The 2025 US measles resurgence was concentrated in communities with low vaccination coverage. Aggregate national and state measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) coverage can mask local susceptibility: pockets of unvaccinated children persist where average coverage appears adequate. School-entry nonmedical exemptions (NMEs) are collected routinely and may capture vaccination behavior and clustering of susceptible children. We examined whether county-level kindergarten NME rates were associated with reporting at least 3 measles cases in 2025, independently of average county MMR coverage. Methods: Cross-sectional ecological study of US counties. Confirmed cases reported January 1 to December 31, 2025, came from the Johns Hopkins University US Measles Tracker. Kindergarten MMR coverage and NME rates (school year 2023-2024 or, if unavailable, 2022- 2023) came from public state reports and published county-level compilations. The prespecified outbreak proxy was 3 or more versus 0-2 reported cases per county, a count threshold without verified epidemiologic linkage. A secondary, exploratory outcome was total case burden among counties with 3 or more cases. Firth penalized logistic regression estimated odds ratios (ORs) for occurrence; negative binomial regression with a log county-population offset and state-clustered robust standard errors estimated incidence rate ratios (IRRs) for burden. Models adjusted for percentage foreign-born, metropolitan status, population density, percentage uninsured, college education, 2024 presidential vote share, and primary care physician supply; estimates are per 1-percentage-point increase. Sensitivity analyses varied the threshold and adjustment set and examined spatial dependence, international airport proximity, state exclusions, and modified Poisson estimation. Only aggregate, publicly available data were analyzed; the study was exempt from institutional review. Results: The sample comprised 1914 counties in 30 states (237 million residents, 71.6% of the US population), capturing 1821 of 2214 reported 2025 cases (82.2%); 66 counties (3.4%) met the outbreak proxy. Mean (SD) MMR coverage was 91.1% (7.2%) and mean NME rate 4.58% (4.37%). In the joint model, each 1-percentage-point higher NME rate was associated with higher odds of meeting the proxy (OR 1.16; 95% CI 1.09-1.24; P<.001), whereas average MMR coverage was not (OR 1.01; 95% CI 0.96 1.07; P=.78). The exemption association persisted across thresholds of 1 to 10 or more cases (ORs 1.12-1.17), with reduced adjustment (OR 1.15), airport-proximity adjustment (OR 1.16), and modified Poisson estimation (risk ratio 1.14; 95% CI 1.06-1.23). Residual spatial autocorrelation was present (Moran I 0.0758; P=.001), and adding neighboring counties' exemption rates attenuated the OR to 1.12 (95% CI 1.03-1.20). In the exploratory burden model, the IRR was 1.08 (95% CI 1.00-1.16; P=.046), with confidence intervals crossing the null in several specifications. Conclusions: Across US counties in 2025, kindergarten nonmedical exemption rates were associated with clustered measles case reports independently of average MMR coverage, which carried little additional information once exemptions were considered. Estimates are ecological, not individual-level or causal; the count proxy did not establish epidemiologic linkage, and exposure definitions varied across states. Routinely collected school-entry exemption data may nonetheless complement local knowledge when pediatricians, school health programs, and health departments prioritize school-level review and outbreak preparedness.

title: Divergent estimates of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis risk after measles and the projected burden of the 2023–2026 resurgence: a Bayesian modelling study
abstract: Abstract Background Published estimates of the risk of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis after measles differ more than tenfold, and the burden of the 2023–2026 measles resurgence is unknown. We examined why and projected that burden. Methods Nine populations with counts of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis and measles denominators were identified from the literature, and a structured search of three databases checked completeness. Counts were expressed as observed/expected ratios under the 1991 England and Wales reference model. Bayesian hierarchical Poisson models compared study design and the way measles infections were counted (a covariate specified after earlier analyses) as explanations for differences between populations, assessed by leave-one-out cross-validation, permutation tests and 30 prespecified sensitivity analyses. Risk per infection was then applied to infections implied by measles cases reported to the World Health Organization from January 2023 to mid-October 2026. Results The populations contributed 499 cases; observed/expected ratios ranged from 0.33 to 8.14. The three populations whose denominators estimated all infections had ratios of 1.6 or less, whereas five of six with denominators counting notifications or clinic visits had ratios of about 4 to 8 (ratio 6.7, 95% credible interval 2.1–19.3). Study design fitted about as well (ratio 5.5, 1.6–16.9); the two explanations could not be separated. Relative to older ages, risk after infection in infancy was about twice that assumed by the reference (multiplier 2.1, 1.2–3.5), although the interval included 1 when either of two strata was omitted. The reported cases correspond to about 40 million infections, which are projected to cause a median of 1,564 (95% interval 254–10,376) to 2,601 (379–18,509) cases depending on the explanation, or about half if scaled to officially reported cases. More than 90% of onsets will occur after 2026, peaking around 2030. Conclusions How measles infections were counted may explain much of this variation but cannot be separated from study design; published risks should not be transferred between settings without accounting for the denominator. Under either explanation, the 2023–2026 resurgence is projected to cause hundreds to thousands of cases, mostly during 2027–2035, leaving time to strengthen surveillance and protect infants.

source_records.abstract: Abstract Background Published estimates of the risk of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis after measles differ more than tenfold, and the burden of the 2023–2026 measles resurgence is unknown. We examined why and projected that burden. Methods Nine populations with counts of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis and measles denominators were identified from the literature, and a structured search of three databases checked completeness. Counts were expressed as observed/expected ratios under the 1991 England and Wales reference model. Bayesian hierarchical Poisson models compared study design and the way measles infections were counted (a covariate specified after earlier analyses) as explanations for differences between populations, assessed by leave-one-out cross-validation, permutation tests and 30 prespecified sensitivity analyses. Risk per infection was then applied to infections implied by measles cases reported to the World Health Organization from January 2023 to mid-October 2026. Results The populations contributed 499 cases; observed/expected ratios ranged from 0.33 to 8.14. The three populations whose denominators estimated all infections had ratios of 1.6 or less, whereas five of six with denominators counting notifications or clinic visits had ratios of about 4 to 8 (ratio 6.7, 95% credible interval 2.1–19.3). Study design fitted about as well (ratio 5.5, 1.6–16.9); the two explanations could not be separated. Relative to older ages, risk after infection in infancy was about twice that assumed by the reference (multiplier 2.1, 1.2–3.5), although the interval included 1 when either of two strata was omitted. The reported cases correspond to about 40 million infections, which are projected to cause a median of 1,564 (95% interval 254–10,376) to 2,601 (379–18,509) cases depending on the explanation, or about half if scaled to officially reported cases. More than 90% of onsets will occur after 2026, peaking around 2030. Conclusions How measles infections were counted may explain much of this variation but cannot be separated from study design; published risks should not be transferred between settings without accounting for the denominator. Under either explanation, the 2023–2026 resurgence is projected to cause hundreds to thousands of cases, mostly during 2027–2035, leaving time to strengthen surveillance and protect infants.

title: Measles: from elimination to resurgence. A literature review and current recommendations
abstract: Measles is a highly contagious, vaccine-preventable viral disease of mandatory epidemiological reporting that remains an active global public health threat. Caused by the measles virus (Paramyxoviridae family), a single-serotype pathogen with a basic reproduction number of 12-18, it is transmitted via aerosolized respiratory droplets. The classic clinical presentation begins with a prodrome of fever, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis, followed by Koplik’s spots and a characteristic cephalocaudal maculopapular rash. Diagnosis is confirmed through specific IgM serology, polymerase chain reaction or viral culture. Management is primarily supportive; vitamin A supplementation reduces childhood mortality by up to 62% and is universally recommended by the WHO for all diagnosed children. Complications occur in approximately 30% of cases; the most frequent and usually mild include diarrhea (8%) and otitis media (7-9%), while severe complications include pneumonia, diarrhea, acute encephalitis, acute post-infectious measles encephalomyelitis, and, years later, subacute sclerosing panencephalitis. The most vulnerable populations include children under 5, young adults without prior immunization, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. The MMR vaccine (measles, mumps and rubella) achieves 97% efficacy after two doses and requires population coverage above 93% to sustain herd immunity. In Mexico, declining vaccination rates contributed to more than 12,000 confirmed cases and over 33 deaths accumulated during the 2025–2026 outbreak, predominantly in unvaccinated children. Post-exposure prophylaxis with MMR within 72 hours or immunoglobulin within 6 days is indicated for susceptible high-risk individuals. Global coordination, sustained vaccination campaigns, and heightened clinical awareness remain essential to curb transmission. This article was prepared to provide a comprehensive review of measles, covering the associated risks, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.

abstract_zh: 麻疹 是一种具有高度传染性、可预防的 麻疹 病毒性疾病,需要进行强制流行病学报告,仍然是一个活跃的全球公共卫生威胁。它由 麻疹病毒(副粘病毒科)引起​​,是一种基本繁殖数为 12-18 的单血清型病原体,通过雾化呼吸道飞沫传播。典型的临床表现以发烧、咳嗽、鼻炎和结膜炎等前驱症状开始,随后出现科普利克斑和特征性头尾斑丘疹。诊断 通过特异性 IgM 血清学、聚合酶链式反应或病毒培养来确认。管理层主要是支持性的;补充维生素 A 可使儿童期 死亡率 减少高达 62%,世界卫生组织普遍建议所有确诊儿童都服用维生素 A。大约 30% 的病例会出现并发症;最常见且通常较轻的并发症包括腹泻 (8%) 和中耳炎 (7-9%),而严重并发症包括肺炎、腹泻、急性脑炎、急性感染后 麻疹 脑脊髓炎,以及多年后的 亚急性硬化性全脑炎。最脆弱的人群包括 5 岁以下儿童、未事先接种疫苗的年轻人、孕妇和免疫功能低下的人。MMR 疫苗(麻疹,腮腺炎和风疹)在两次接种后可达到 97% 的疗效,并需要 93% 以上的人群覆盖率才能维持群体免疫。在墨西哥,疫苗接种 发病率下降导致 2025 年至 2026 年 疫苗接种 期间累计确诊病例超过 12,000 例,死亡人数累计超过 33 例,其中主要是未接种疫苗的儿童。对于易感高危个体,需要在 72 小时内使用 MMR 或在 6 天内使用免疫球蛋白进行暴露后预防。全球协调、持续的 疫苗接种 活动和提高临床意识对于遏制 传播 仍然至关重要。本文旨在对 麻疹 进行全面回顾,涵盖相关风险、诊断、治疗 和预防。

title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
journal: CAUCHY Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

title_zh: 具有不完整 疫苗接种 和 1 个免疫力减弱的 麻疹 的 SVIR 模型分析:Sidoarjo-Indonesia 案例
source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

title: Risk factors associated with the resurgence of confirmed measles cases in Senegal in the post Covid-19 period
abstract: Measles is one of the most contagious infectious diseases, responsible for significant morbidity and mortality through recurring epidemics. In Senegal, a resurgence of confirmed measles cases was observed, with epidemics occurring between 2021 and 2024. The goal of this study is to identify factors significantly associated with laboratory-confirmed status among notified measles cases in Senegal in the post-Covid-19 context. A cross-sectional analytical study was conducted on all suspected measles cases notified in the health districts of Senegal from January 2015 to December 2024 ( n = 9 935), each classified as confirmed, doubtful, or ruled out. Confirmed cases were described separately ( n = 2 448). Statistical analyses were performed using R software with Cramér’s V, Multiple Correspondence Analysis, and multivariable binary logistic regression comparing confirmed cases with doubtful/ruled-out cases. Among 9 935 suspected measles cases notified over the study period, 2 448 were laboratory-confirmed. Patients ranged in age from 1 to 81 years, with a mean age of 9 years. Several factors were associated with laboratory-confirmed status. The Kédougou region (OR: 5, 95% CI [3.71–6.78], p < 2.2e- 16 ) was associated with a fivefold increased risk of a confirmed measles case. Insufficient vaccination coverage for the second dose (RR2) was strongly linked to confirmed status (OR: 3.34, 95% CI [2.83–3.95], p < 2.2e- 16 ). The risk was also four times higher in unvaccinated individuals (OR: 4.03, 95% CI [3.54–4.6], p < 2.2e- 16 ). Finally, children aged 1 to 5 years (OR: 1.39, 95% CI [1.24–1.55], p = 0.0003593) appear to be a particularly vulnerable age group, with an increased risk compared to other age groups. This study identified and ranked the principal risk factors associated with the resurgence of confirmed measles cases in Senegal. These findings could inform future research exploring machine-learning-based approaches to outbreak risk prediction; however, the development and validation of any such decision-support tool remain beyond the scope of the present analysis.

title: Wastewater-Based Surveillance as a Complementary Tool for Measles Outbreak Detection in Under-Vaccinated Communities in Israel
abstract: Measles outbreaks have re-emerged globally, particularly in communities with suboptimal vaccination coverage, highlighting the need for complementary surveillance approaches. We evaluated wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) as a tool for detecting and monitoring measles virus (MeV) outbreaks in Israel during 2025. Weekly wastewater samples were collected from seven surveillance catchments between June and December 2025, concentrated using membrane filtration, and analyzed by digital PCR (dPCR). Environmental findings were compared with laboratory-confirmed measles cases assigned to the corresponding wastewater catchments. MeV RNA was detected in only two of the seven monitored sites, Beit Shemesh and Safed, both serving communities with low vaccination coverage (<82%). In these catchments, wastewater MeV RNA concentrations closely mirrored the dynamics of laboratory-confirmed cases, while no MeV RNA was detected in the remaining five sites despite continuous surveillance. In Safed, increases in wastewater MeV RNA concentrations preceded the rise in laboratory-confirmed cases by approximately one week, demonstrating the potential of WBE as an early-warning system. Our findings demonstrate that wastewater surveillance is a valuable epidemiological tool that complements conventional surveillance and has the potential to improve situational awareness of measles outbreaks, assist public health decision-making, and facilitate targeted interventions in vulnerable populations.

Environmental findings were compared with laboratory-confirmed measles cases assigned to the corresponding wastewater catchments. MeV RNA was detected in only two of the seven monitored sites, Beit Shemesh and Safed, both serving communities with low vaccination coverage (<82%). In these catchments, wastewater MeV RNA concentrations closely mirrored the dynamics of laboratory-confirmed cases, while no MeV RNA was detected in the remaining five sites despite continuous surveillance. In Safed, increases in wastewater MeV RNA concentrations preceded the rise in laboratory-confirmed cases by approximately one week, demonstrating the potential of WBE as an early-warning system. Our findings demonstrate that wastewater surveillance is a valuable epidemiological tool that complements conventional surveillance and has the potential to improve situational awareness of measles outbreaks, assist public health decision-making, and facilitate targeted interventions in vulnerable populations.

title: Adaptive Sliding Mode Control for Vaccination and Treatment in a Measles Transmission Model
abstract: Measles remains a highly contagious vaccine-preventable disease, and persistent outbreaks highlight the need for effective intervention strategies combining prevention and treatment. This study develops an extended measles transmission model consisting of susceptible, vaccinated, exposed, infectious, hospitalized, and recovered populations, with two time-dependent control inputs representing vaccination and treatment. An Adaptive Sliding Mode Control (ASMC) strategy is proposed to regulate the vaccinated population toward a prescribed trajectory while suppressing the infectious population. Normalized sliding surfaces are constructed for the vaccinated and infectious states, and adaptive gains incorporating a dead-zone mechanism are introduced to prevent unnecessary gain growth. The positivity and boundedness of the epidemiological model solutions are established, while Lyapunov analysis demonstrates exponential convergence of the ideal sliding dynamics when the control saturation constraints are inactive. Numerical simulations are conducted over 200 weeks with an initial population of 10 million individuals, comparing the proposed ASMC strategy with an uncontrolled scenario under the same initial conditions and epidemiological parameters. The uncontrolled infectious population reaches a peak of approximately (364,005) individuals, whereas under ASMC it does not exceed its initial value of (75,900), corresponding to a (79.15%) reduction in the peak infectious population relative to the uncontrolled scenario. At the end of the simulation, the vaccinated population reaches approximately (4.61x10^6) individuals, representing (46.09%) of the modeled population. Moreover, the control inputs and adaptive gains remain bounded throughout the numerical simulation. These findings illustrate the potential of the proposed ASMC framework for coordinating vaccination and treatment interventions and reducing the simulated peak infectious population.

title_zh: 麻疹 传播 模型中 疫苗接种 和 治疗 的自适应滑模控制
source_body_en: Measles remains a highly contagious vaccine-preventable disease, and persistent outbreaks highlight the need for effective intervention strategies combining prevention and treatment. This study develops an extended measles transmission model consisting of susceptible, vaccinated, exposed, infectious, hospitalized, and recovered populations, with two time-dependent control inputs representing vaccination and treatment. An Adaptive Sliding Mode Control (ASMC) strategy is proposed to regulate the vaccinated population toward a prescribed trajectory while suppressing the infectious population. Normalized sliding surfaces are constructed for the vaccinated and infectious states, and adaptive gains incorporating a dead-zone mechanism are introduced to prevent unnecessary gain growth. The positivity and boundedness of the epidemiological model solutions are established, while Lyapunov analysis demonstrates exponential convergence of the ideal sliding dynamics when the control saturation constraints are inactive. Numerical simulations are conducted over 200 weeks with an initial population of 10 million individuals, comparing the proposed ASMC strategy with an uncontrolled scenario under the same initial conditions and epidemiological parameters. The uncontrolled infectious population reaches a peak of approximately (364,005) individuals, whereas under ASMC it does not exceed its initial value of (75,900), corresponding to a (79.15%) reduction in the peak infectious population relative to the uncontrolled scenario. At the end of the simulation, the vaccinated population reaches approximately (4.61x10^6) individuals, representing (46.09%) of the modeled population. Moreover, the control inputs and adaptive gains remain bounded throughout the numerical simulation. These findings illustrate the potential of the proposed ASMC framework for coordinating vaccination and treatment interventions and reducing the simulated peak infectious population.

title: Digital PCR Triplex Assay for the Detection and Differentiation of Wild-Type and Vaccine-Strain Measles Viruses v1
abstract: This protocol describes an optimised triplex digital PCR (dPCR) assay for the detection of measles virus RNA in wastewater and the differentiation of wild-type and vaccine-strain meas measles virus. The assay uses the QIAcuity OneStep Advanced Probe Kit with hydrolysis probes in multiplex reactions on QIAGEN QIAcuity digital PCR instruments. The protocol also provides instructions for the preparation of in-house 20× primer–probe assay mixes. The triplex assay was developed to improve the sensitivity of measles virus surveillance in wastewater by incorporating multiple detection targets into a single reaction. Its implementation has demonstrated an improvement in the overall measles virus detection rate (positivity rate) compared with the use of individual assays. Although the assay is designed to differentiate between wild-type and vaccine-strain measles virus, successful detection of measles virus RNA without definitive strain differentiation should still be considered a valuable surveillance outcome. In such cases, the sample should be reported as measles virus-positive, with strain differentiation recorded as inconclusive. Where definitive strain characterisation is required, whole-genome sequencing (WGS) is recommended. The complementary measles virus whole-genome sequencing protocol provides detailed instructions for the sequencing of measles virus detected in wastewater, enabling further genetic characterisation and strain identification.

Advertisement Counties with higher school-entry nonmedical vaccine exemption rates had greater odds of measles outbreaks in 2025, even after accounting for average MMR coverage, according to the study authors of a research letter in JAMA Network Open.1 Each 1-percentage-point increase in the nonmedical exemption rate was associated with 16% higher odds of a county reporting at least 3 measles cases.1 The findings arrive as the US records its highest measles count since elimination was declared in 2000. They also come days after the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) withdrew the country's elimination status.2,3 The authors examined whether exemption data reveal clusters of susceptible children, which county-wide coverage averages can hide. Researchers from the University of Washington, The Kinkaid School, and George Washington University conducted a cross-sectional ecological study of 1,914 counties across 30 states. These counties held 237,057,569 residents, or 71.6% of the US population. The sample captured 1,821 of the 2,214 measles cases (82.2%) logged in 2025 by the Johns Hopkins University US Measles Tracker.1 The primary outcome was an outbreak proxy of at least 3 reported cases in a county, met by 66 counties (3.4%). Mean kindergarten MMR coverage was 91.1%, and the mean nonmedical exemption rate was 4.58%. In the joint Firth penalized logistic regression model, higher exemption rates were associated with higher odds of meeting the proxy (OR, 1.16; 95% CI, 1.09-1.24; P < .001).1 MMR coverage showed no association with outbreak occurrence once exemptions were in the model (OR, 1.01; 95% CI, 0.96-1.07; P = .78). Under alternative case thresholds, ORs ranged from 1.12 to 1.17, and adjusting for airport proximity yielded an OR of 1.16. Adding neighboring-county exemption rates to address spatial autocorrelation attenuated the estimate to 1.12 (95% CI, 1.03-1.20).1 What You Need to Know Each 1-percentage-point increase in a county's nonmedical exemption rate was linked to 16% higher odds of reaching at least 3 measles cases (OR, 1.16; 95% CI, 1.09-1.24). Average county MMR coverage did not predict outbreaks once exemptions were in the model, likely because county-wide averages hide clusters of susceptible children. The findings arrive as US measles cases reach 5,838 in 2026 and PAHO has withdrawn the country's measles elimination status. Higher exemption rates also tracked with lower county MMR coverage (exponentiated β, 0.93; 95% CI, 0.91-0.95; P < .001).1 In exploratory analyses, higher exemption rates were associated with greater case burden (IRR, 1.08; 95% CI, 1.00-1.16; P = .046).Burden estimates were less consistent, with CIs crossing the null in several specifications.1 According to the authors, the exemption signal may reflect clustering of susceptible children, differential measurement error, or both. They propose using exemption data alongside local knowledge when prioritizing school-level review and outbreak preparedness. However, the study did not test whether monitoring exemptions allows earlier outbreak detection.1 Because counties served as ecological units, the estimates cannot be read as individual-level or causal effects.The 3-case proxy does not establish epidemiologic linkage and could misclassify imported or cross-county outbreaks. Data from only 30 states, possible residual confounding by importation risk and surveillance intensity, and just 66 outcome events further limit the findings.1 US Measles Cases Climb as the Country Loses Elimination Status The CDC reported 5,838 confirmed measles cases as of November 19, according to Contagion's November 20 update. The count rose by 426 cases (7.9%) from the prior week and is about 2.6 times the 2,289 cases recorded in all of 2025. Cases span 47 jurisdictions, and 96% (5,629 of 5,838) are outbreak-associated.2 The CDC lists 591 hospitalizations (11%) and six deaths in 2026, while state health departments report 10 measles-associated deaths. Ninety-six percent of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Kindergarten MMR coverage fell from 95.2% in 2019-2020 to 92.4% in 2025-2026, leaving about 280,000 kindergartners at risk.2 On November 17, PAHO Director Jarbas Barbosa announced the regional re-verification commission had found endemic transmission reestablished in the US, Bolivia, and Mexico. All three countries lost elimination status. To regain it, the US must submit a corrective action plan and go at least 12 months without endemic transmission.3 Large outbreaks remain active in Indiana, Minnesota, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin, and New York State has declared a state of emergency. The CDC reports investing $100 million in state and local health departments as part of the response.2 References Ahmed HM, Kayani R, Yang YT. title: About the measles epidemic in the Yakut region in 1900–1901
abstract: Although measles outbreaks were repeatedly recorded in Yakutia during the pre-Soviet period, the largest outbreak, in 1900–1901, has not yet been described in detail in the scientific literature, and its documented scale has not been established from the available sources. To reconstruct, for the first time, the course and consequences of the largest measles epidemic in Yakutia in 1900–1901 and establish its documented scale using available archival sources. Materials & Methods. A comparative analysis was conducted of parish registers from 70 Orthodox churches and two mission stations in northeastern Russia. Records for 1899–1903 held by the National Archive of the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia) and the State Archive of the Irkutsk Region were examined, with a focus on documented measles deaths. The earliest recorded measles deaths occurred in the Bodaibo area in the summer of 1899. In the spring of 1900, the infection spread to the Olekminsk and Vilyuisk districts. Mortality peaked in the Yakutsk district in November 1900, predominantly in the Lena–Amga interfluve. In the winter of 1900–1901, measles deaths were recorded in parish registers in the Verkhoyansk district, including the Bulun and Ust-Yana parishes beyond the Arctic Circle. From the beginning of 1901, measles spread widely across the Kolyma district along the Verkhoyansk–Kolyma route. The findings trace the spread of infection, describe the age and sex distribution of deaths and document the organization of assistance. The possible role of migration and living conditions in the epidemic is considered. Historical sources contribute to understanding past epidemiological processes and inform discussion of modern strategies for preventing infectious diseases. Particular attention is paid to mortality peaks, geographical coverage and the age and sex distribution of deaths. The proportion of adults among the deceased was higher in the Kolyma district than in the western and central districts. Low population immunity is considered only as a possible explanation for these differences. The Kolyma district illustrates the role of medical workers, political exiles and local residents in organizing assistance. The study demonstrates that a measles outbreak can develop into a large-scale disaster even in areas with low population density and limited transport infrastructure.

abstract_zh: 尽管麻疹 麻疹 暴发在前苏联时期在雅库特被多次记录,但最大的麻疹,在1900-1901年,尚未在科学文献中详细描述,并且其记录的规模尚未从现有来源确定。首次重建 1900 年至 1901 年雅库特最大规模 麻疹 流行病的过程和后果,并利用现有档案来源确定其记录规模。材料与方法。对俄罗斯东北部 70 个东正教教堂和两个传教站的教区登记册进行了比较分析。对萨哈共和国国家档案馆(雅库特)和伊尔库茨克地区国家档案馆保存的 1899 年至 1903 年的记录进行了检查,重点是记录在案的 麻疹 死亡事件。最早有记录的麻疹死亡事件发生在1899年夏天的博代博地区。1900年春天,感染蔓延到奥列克明斯克和维柳伊斯克地区。死亡率 于 1900 年 11 月在雅库茨克地区达到顶峰,主要发生在勒拿河与阿姆加河交汇处。1900 年至 1901 年冬季,维尔霍扬斯克地区的教区登记册中记录了 麻疹 死亡人数,其中包括北极圈以外的布伦教区和乌斯季亚纳教区。从 1901 年初开始,麻疹 沿着维尔霍扬斯克-科雷马路线在科雷马地区广泛传播。研究结果追踪了感染的传播情况,描述了死亡人数的年龄和性别分布,并记录了援助的组织情况。考虑了迁徙和生活条件在疫情中可能发挥的作用。历史资料有助于了解过去的流行病学过程,并为预防传染病的现代策略的讨论提供信息。特别关注 死亡率 峰值、地理覆盖范围以及死亡人数的年龄和性别分布。科累马地区死者中成年人的比例高于西部和中部地区。低群体免疫力仅被认为是这些差异的可能解释。科雷马地区体现了医务人员、政治流亡者和当地居民在组织援助方面发挥的作用。研究表明,即使在人口密度低和交通基础设施有限的地区,麻疹 暴发 也可能发展成为大规模灾难。

title: Longitudinal study of the dynamics of post-vaccination humoral immunity against measles among staff of an infectious disease centre
abstract: Measles remains a significant public health concern, and healthcare workers represent a high-risk group for infection and a potential source of nosocomial transmission. Data on the long-term dynamics of post-vaccination humoral immunity to measles among healthcare workers remain limited. To study the long-term dynamics of anti-measles IgG antibody levels among staff of a medical organization and to identify factors associated with the direction of these changes. Materials & Methods. A longitudinal study was conducted using serological screening data for measles IgG antibodies among staff of a medical organization collected from 2013 to 2025. Data from 571 measurements in 216 individuals with at least two IgG determinations by ELISA («VektoKor’ IgG» test system) were analyzed. A concentration ≥ 0.18 IU/mL was considered protective. The mean IgG concentration was 1.22 IU/mL, with a protective level recorded in 86.5 % of measurements. Ordinary linear regression across all 571 measurements yielded a negative slope (β = −0.058 IU/mL/year; R2 = 0.023). Within-participant dependence was not accounted for; therefore, the nominal p < 0.001 does not establish a statistically significant longitudinal trend. Participants were divided into groups according to the direction of IgG change with increasing (48.6 %), decreasing (41.7 %), and stable (9.7 %) titers; occupation was significantly associated with this distribution (an increase was more common among medical staff – 54.2 % vs 34.4 % among non-medical staff; p = 0.031). A strong negative correlation was found between the baseline IgG level and its subsequent annual change (r = –0.582; p < 0.0001), compatible with regression to the mean and mathematical coupling between baseline and change. Among twice-vaccinated individuals with an initially protective antibody level, IgG fell below 0.18 IU/mL at the last measurement in 2 of 41 participants (4.9 %). Measles IgG levels among staff of the infectious disease centre changed in different directions, with high inter-individual variability. IgG increases were more frequent among medical staff; the role of subclinical exposure to measles virus was not established by this study. Loss of the serological protective level in some twicevaccinated participants warrants further study; clinical protection and the effectiveness of additional vaccination were not assessed.

title: MODERN APPROACHES TO THE PREVENTION OF MEASLES AMONG CHILDREN AND ADULTS
abstract: Measles is one of the most contagious viral infections and remains a significant threat to public health, particularly among young children and individuals without immunity. Despite the availability of effective vaccines, measles outbreaks continue to occur in different countries due to insufficient vaccination coverage, population migration, and gaps in herd immunity. Modern measles prevention includes routine and supplementary immunization, epidemiological surveillance, early detection of cases, isolation of infected individuals, and public health education. Particular importance is given to increasing vaccination coverage among children and adults, especially those belonging to high-risk groups.
journal: Modern American Journal of Medical and Health Sciences

title: Intensity of post-vaccination immunity against measles in children according to a retrospective study
abstract: Objective: a retrospective assessment of the intensity of humoral immunity in children vaccinated against measles with various somatic diseases, depending on age and vaccination status. Materials and methods: A retrospective study included 171 patients aged 1 to 18 years who were exposed to anti-epidemic measures for contact with measles at the department of the Children's City Clinical Hospital No. The assessment of the intensity of humoral immunity was carried out by enzyme immunoassay. Results: Among children with documented vaccination, the proportion of seronegative patients among those vaccinated once between the ages of 1 and 6 years was 20.6%, among those vaccinated twice over the age of 6 years — 18.1%. There were no statistically significant differences between the proportions of patients ( p = 0.69). Conclusion: The high proportion of seronegative children among the vaccinated population exceeds the threshold recommended by Rospotrebnadzor of 7% among those vaccinated and requires further research.

abstract_zh: 目的:回顾性评估接种麻疹疫苗的儿童在不同年龄和疫苗接种状态下体液免疫强度。材料和方法:回顾性研究纳入了171名1至18岁在儿童市临床医院部门因接触麻疹而接受抗流行措施的患者。通过酶免疫法评估体液免疫强度。结果:在有疫苗接种记录的儿童中,1至6岁接种一次疫苗的患者中血清阴性比例为20.6%,6岁以上接种两次疫苗的患者中血清阴性比例为18.1%。两组患者比例之间无统计学显著差异(p = 0.69)。结论:接种麻疹疫苗的儿童中血清阴性比例较高,超过俄罗斯联邦消费者权益保护和公共健康监督局推荐的7%阈值,需要进一步研究。

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to compare the epidemiological and clinical-laboratory features of measles in children and adults in the Belgorod region during 2023—2025, addressing the knowledge gap regarding the disease's variability across age groups.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective analysis of medical records was conducted on 51 patients with a laboratory-confirmed diagnosis of measles virus infection in the Belgorod region between 2023 and 2025.
analysis.methods: The study involved reviewing medical records to analyze epidemiological and clinical-laboratory features of measles cases, including age distribution, transmission modes, and symptom prevalence.
analysis.main_results: The analysis revealed that 90.1% of measles cases in the Belgorod region were registered among unvaccinated individuals, with 37.3% of cases being imported and intra-family contacts accounting for 59.4% of transmission within the region.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the significant role of unvaccinated individuals in measles transmission and the dominance of intra-family spread, offering novel insights into the epidemiological patterns of measles in the region.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of vaccination programs and public health measures targeting unvaccinated populations and family-based transmission dynamics in controlling measles outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on retrospective medical records, which may introduce recall bias, and the evidence is limited to the Belgorod region, reducing generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted a comparative analysis of measles epidemiological and clinical-laboratory features in children and adults in the Belgorod region from 2023 to 2025. It found that 90.1% of cases were among unvaccinated individuals, with 37.3% being imported and intra-family contacts accounting for 59.4% of transmission. The disease was typically moderate in severity (82.3% of patients), but adults showed higher rates of severe disease and complications. The study emphasizes the need for targeted vaccination and public health interventions to address unvaccinated populations and family-based transmission. However, the retrospective design and regional focus limit the generalizability of the findings, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

title: Oncolytic measles virus reprograms the tumor microenvironment in a vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip model
abstract: Abstract Background Pleural mesothelioma (PM) is a rare and aggressive cancer primarily caused by asbestos exposure. Although dual immune checkpoint inhibition (anti-PD-1/anti-CTLA-4) is now approved as first-line therapy, clinical benefit is limited to a small subset of patients, necessitating the need for alternative strategies. Oncolytic viruses represent a promising therapeutic approach as they selectively infect and lyse tumor cells and display immunogenic properties. In PM, we showed that the oncolytic activity of measles virus (MV) is primarily dependent on alterations in the type I interferon (IFN-I) pathway. However, to date no in vitro models have yet been developed to mimic a sophisticated tumor microenvironment (TME), and accurately evaluate MV efficacy in PM. Methods We designed a humanized 3D “vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip” (VMOC) model using microfluidic chips that mimic a TME. VMOCs are generated using primary endothelial cells, lung fibroblasts and patient-derived PM cells. We characterized the functionality of our model by confocal imaging, perfusion assay and single-cell RNA sequencing. The impact of MV on the VMOC was assessed by bulk transcriptomics, multiplex ELISA and deconvolution strategies, and compared to clinical data in patients with PM. Results We first proved VMOC functionality with an appropriate endothelial barrier integrity, perfusability, and vascular responsiveness to external stimuli. We demonstrated significant heterogeneity in the VMOC, with the presence of different mesenchymal, cancer and endothelial subpopulations. Interestingly, the addition of PM cells to the VMOC reduced both the IFN-I pathway in cells from the TME, and the abundance of a novel endothelial cell subset characterized by an IFN-I signaling signature. Following MV administration via the endothelial network, we detected PM cell infection and death, as well as strong activation of the IFN-I pathway with the production of multiple inflammatory mediators. Interestingly, the proteomic and transcriptomic inflammatory response induced by MV in VMOCs was similar to that induced in PM patients treated with an oncolytic virus. Conclusions The VMOC model we developed enables in vitro investigation of MV infection and TME reprogramming, paving the way for a deeper understanding of the TME role in OV responses and the development of novel strategies to improve clinical efficacy.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在满足体外模型的需求,以评估溶瘤剂 麻疹病毒 (MV) 对胸膜间皮瘤 (PM) 的疗效,这是一种主要由石棉暴露引起的罕见且侵袭性癌症。尽管双重免疫检查点抑制现已被批准作为一线治疗,但临床获益仅限于一小部分患者,因此需要替代策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用微流控芯片设计了人性化 3D“芯片上血管化间皮瘤”(VMOC) 模型来模拟 PM 的肿瘤微环境 (TME)。该模型是使用原代内皮细胞、肺成纤维细胞和患者来源的 PM 细胞生成的。

title_zh: 溶瘤 麻疹病毒 在血管化间皮瘤芯片模型中重新编程肿瘤微环境
source_body_en: Abstract Background Pleural mesothelioma (PM) is a rare and aggressive cancer primarily caused by asbestos exposure. Although dual immune checkpoint inhibition (anti-PD-1/anti-CTLA-4) is now approved as first-line therapy, clinical benefit is limited to a small subset of patients, necessitating the need for alternative strategies. Oncolytic viruses represent a promising therapeutic approach as they selectively infect and lyse tumor cells and display immunogenic properties. In PM, we showed that the oncolytic activity of measles virus (MV) is primarily dependent on alterations in the type I interferon (IFN-I) pathway. However, to date no in vitro models have yet been developed to mimic a sophisticated tumor microenvironment (TME), and accurately evaluate MV efficacy in PM. Methods We designed a humanized 3D “vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip” (VMOC) model using microfluidic chips that mimic a TME. VMOCs are generated using primary endothelial cells, lung fibroblasts and patient-derived PM cells. We characterized the functionality of our model by confocal imaging, perfusion assay and single-cell RNA sequencing. The impact of MV on the VMOC was assessed by bulk transcriptomics, multiplex ELISA and deconvolution strategies, and compared to clinical data in patients with PM. Results We first proved VMOC functionality with an appropriate endothelial barrier integrity, perfusability, and vascular responsiveness to external stimuli. We demonstrated significant heterogeneity in the VMOC, with the presence of different mesenchymal, cancer and endothelial subpopulations. Interestingly, the addition of PM cells to the VMOC reduced both the IFN-I pathway in cells from the TME, and the abundance of a novel endothelial cell subset characterized by an IFN-I signaling signature. Following MV administration via the endothelial network, we detected PM cell infection and death, as well as strong activation of the IFN-I pathway with the production of multiple inflammatory mediators. Interestingly, the proteomic and transcriptomic inflammatory response induced by MV in VMOCs was similar to that induced in PM patients treated with an oncolytic virus. Conclusions The VMOC model we developed enables in vitro investigation of MV infection and TME reprogramming, paving the way for a deeper understanding of the TME role in OV responses and the development of novel strategies to improve clinical efficacy.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 胸膜间皮瘤 (PM) 是一种罕见的侵袭性癌症,主要由石棉暴露引起。尽管双重免疫检查点抑制(抗 PD-1/抗 CTLA-4)现已被批准作为一线治疗,但临床获益仅限于一小部分患者,因此需要替代策略。溶瘤病毒代表了一种有前途的治疗方法,因为它们选择性地感染和裂解肿瘤细胞并表现出免疫原性。在 PM 中,我们发现 麻疹病毒 (MV) 的溶瘤活性主要依赖于 I 型干扰素 (IFN-I) 途径的改变。然而,迄今为止,尚未开发出体外模型来模拟复杂的肿瘤微环境 (TME),并准确评估 MV 对 PM 的疗效。方法我们使用模仿 TME 的微流控芯片设计了人性化 3D“芯片上血管化间皮瘤”(VMOC) 模型。VMOC 使用原代内皮细胞、肺成纤维细胞和患者来源的 PM 细胞产生。我们通过共聚焦成像、灌注测定和单细胞 RNA 测序来表征我们模型的功能。通过批量转录组学、多重 ELISA 和反卷积策略评估 MV 对 VMOC 的影响,并与 PM 患者的临床数据进行比较。结果我们首先证明了 VMOC 具有适当的内皮屏障完整性、可灌注性和血管对外部刺激的反应性的功能。我们证明了 VMOC 存在显着的异质性,存在不同的间充质、癌症和内皮亚群。有趣的是,将PM细胞添加到VMOC中既减少了来自TME的细胞中的IFN-I途径,也减少了以IFN-I信号传导特征为特征的新型内皮细胞亚群的丰度。通过内皮网络给予 MV 后,我们检测到 PM 细胞感染和死亡,以及 IFN-I 途径的强烈激活和多种炎症介质的产生。有趣的是,MV 在 VMOC 中诱导的蛋白质组和转录组炎症反应与用溶瘤病毒治疗的 PM 患者诱导的相似。结论 我们开发的 VMOC 模型能够对 MV 感染和 TME 重编程进行体外研究,为更深入地了解 TME 在 OV 反应中的作用以及开发提高临床疗效的新策略铺平道路。

title: Characterizing the relative strength of metapopulation dynamics in measles persistence
abstract: Background/Aims Measles is a highly infectious, vaccine-preventable disease that remains persistent across much of the world despite continued large-scale control efforts. Local dynamics of measles are shaped by births of susceptible individuals and seasonal drivers of transmission, while broader regional dynamics are shaped by population mobility and metapopulation connectivity. Incidence data, useful for tracking the progress of measles control, are frequently reported only at the aggregate level (e.g., states/provinces), and persistence at this scale may arise because of the independent persistence in all local sub-units or because of regional metapopulation dynamics. Disentangling the contribution of local versus regional persistence is critical in identifying effective strategies for control. Methods/Results We show, as vaccination reduces local measles prevalence, metapopulation colonization and extinction events dominate regional persistence. This manifests as a change in the seasonal distribution of cases throughout the year; incidence becomes more uniformly distributed through the year even with no change in underlying seasonal drivers. We demonstrate this using: 1) a seasonally forced, stochastic metapopulation compartmental model; 2) historical measles incidence in the USA; and 3) recent subnational-level measles incidence in Nigeria. We create a novel, scale-free measure to quantify the contribution of metapopulation dynamics to persistence, roundness, defined as the geometric mean of the scaled maximum and minimum monthly incidence. A low value of roundness indicates strong local persistence dominated by the seasonal attractor, while a high value indicates strong metapopulation persistence. We illustrate the properties of this measure using simulations and observed data. In the USA, roundness nearly doubled after the introduction of the measles-containing vaccine. In Nigeria, roundness is well correlated with observed vaccine coverage, with a Pearson's r of 0.70 (95% CI: 0.57, 0.80), discriminating between northern states dominated by local persistence of measles and southern states where persistence is maintained by regional dynamics. Conclusion Identifying how measles persists is important in its control; vaccination strategies may differ if persistence is largely local, or if persistence is driven by connectivity from surrounding areas, even where yearly incidence is comparable. Our approach can be valuable areas where other measures (connectivity, mobility, laboratory confirmed illness) are not widely available.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 方法/结果我们表明,随着 疫苗接种 减少局部 麻疹 患病率,集合种群定殖和灭绝事件主导区域持久性。

elements_zh.main_results: In Nigeria, roundness is well correlated with observed vaccine coverage, with a Pearson's r of 0.70 (95% CI: 0.57, 0.80), discriminating between northern states dominated by local persistence of measles and southern states where persistence is maintained by regional dynamics.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结论 确定 麻疹 的持续存在方式对于控制 麻疹 非常重要;如果持久性主要是本地的,或者如果持久性是由周围区域的连接驱动的,则 疫苗接种 策略可能会有所不同,即使年度 发病率 具有可比性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 我们创建了一种新颖的无标度测量方法来量化集合种群动态对持久性和圆度的贡献,定义为按比例缩放的每月最大和最小 发病率 的几何平均值。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 我们的方法可以在其他措施(连通性、移动性、实验室确诊疾病)尚未广泛应用的领域发挥重要作用。

title: Quantifying the relationship between exposure to natural disasters and early-childhood immunization in low- and middle-income countries.
abstract: Limited research has explored the relationship between exposure to natural hazards and antenatal and early childhood vaccination indicators. We leveraged individual-level data from Young Lives: An International Study of Childhood Poverty surveys conducted in 2002 to estimate the association of household exposure to natural disaster in Ethiopia, India (in the states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana), Peru, and Vietnam on antenatal and early childhood vaccinations among mother/child pairs. We ran mixed-effects logistic regression models with interaction between exposure to natural disaster and vaccine type (≥ 2 doses of antenatal tetanus during antenatal visits, postnatal BCG [Bacillus Calmette-Guérin], postnatal measles), controlled for wealth index and child age as fixed effects, and included nested random effects with country, sentinel site, and individual ID. We found that the association between exposure to natural disaster and vaccination varied by vaccine type. Exposure to natural disaster was associated with an increased probability of receiving ≥ 2 doses of antenatal tetanus vaccine during antenatal visits of 5.75 percentage points (estimate: 0.0575; 95% CI: 0.0186, 0.0964), and a decreased probability of receiving postnatal BCG vaccine against tuberculosis of 3.11 percentage points (estimate: -0.0311; 95% CI: -0.0576, -0.00455). We did not find a significant association for postnatal measles vaccination (estimate: 0.00647; 95% CI: -0.03, 0.0429). This study finds that exposure to natural disasters is associated with antenatal and early childhood vaccination, underscoring the importance of increasing immunization efforts for specific vaccines in areas recently affected by natural disasters. However, further studies are needed to verify results and establish causation.

We found that the association between exposure to natural disaster and vaccination varied by vaccine type. Exposure to natural disaster was associated with an increased probability of receiving ≥ 2 doses of antenatal tetanus vaccine during antenatal visits of 5.75 percentage points (estimate: 0.0575; 95% CI: 0.0186, 0.0964), and a decreased probability of receiving postnatal BCG vaccine against tuberculosis of 3.11 percentage points (estimate: -0.0311; 95% CI: -0.0576, -0.00455). This study finds that exposure to natural disasters is associated with antenatal and early childhood vaccination, underscoring the importance of increasing immunization efforts for specific vaccines in areas recently affected by natural disasters. However, further studies are needed to verify results and establish causation.

title: GAPS in Protection Against Vaccine-Preventable Infections in Patients Post-Haematopoietic Stem Cell Transplant for Primary Immunodeficiency Syndromes.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Patients with primary immunodeficiency (PID) syndromes are susceptible to vaccine-preventable infections post-haematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT). Timely re-immunisation following immune reconstitution is critical. METHOD: HSCTs conducted 2018-2025 at Starship Children's Hospital (New Zealand) to treat children (age ≤18 years) were identified through the institutional database. Local and national electronic medical records, clinical and laboratory data, and vaccination records (Aotearoa Immunisation Register) were reviewed. Post-HSCT re-immunisation eligibility criteria and audit standards were based on National Child Cancer Network NZ guidelines. RESULTS: Of 197 unique patients who received 236 HSCTs, 28 patients had PID as the reason for HSCT. Patients were excluded if they were not currently cleared for re-immunisation for clinical reasons (n = 2) or died within 6 months of HSCT (n = 4). Twenty-two patients who were eligible for re-immunisation were included for this preliminary report. One of 22 (4.5%) had not commenced re-immunisation. Median time between the date of clearance for re-immunisation and administration of the first non-live vaccine was 64 days (interquartile range [IQR] 9-126 days). Deviation from standard vaccination sequence occurred in 33% of patients (7/21). At any one visit, 85% (18/21) were not given all eligible vaccines. 9% (2/22) were fully up-to-date with re-immunisations at the time of audit. Twenty patients were eligible for live vaccines. 65% (13/20) were given at least one dose of a measles-containing vaccine (MCV). Median time between last blood product administration and first dose of MCV was 669 days (IQR 476-766 days). 50% (10/20) received 2 doses of MCV. 40% (4/10) had post-MCV measles serology checked; one individual remained seronegative despite 2 doses of MCV. CONCLUSION: Completion of re-immunisation schedules post-HSCT is suboptimal, leaving gaps in protection against vaccine-preventable infections. There is considerable delay between clearance for re-immunisation and commencement. Uptake of MCV and the practice of confirming seroconversion is highly variable.

source_records.abstract: Introduction Patients with primary immunodeficiency (PID) syndromes are susceptible to vaccine-preventable infections post-haematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT). Timely re-immunisation following immune reconstitution is critical. Method HSCTs conducted 2018-2025 at Starship Children's Hospital (New Zealand) to treat children (age ≤18 years) were identified through the institutional database. Local and national electronic medical records, clinical and laboratory data, and vaccination records (Aotearoa Immunisation Register) were reviewed. Post-HSCT re-immunisation eligibility criteria and audit standards were based on National Child Cancer Network NZ guidelines. Results Of 197 unique patients who received 236 HSCTs, 28 patients had PID as the reason for HSCT. Patients were excluded if they were not currently cleared for re-immunisation for clinical reasons (n = 2) or died within 6 months of HSCT (n = 4). Twenty-two patients who were eligible for re-immunisation were included for this preliminary report. One of 22 (4.5%) had not commenced re-immunisation. Median time between the date of clearance for re-immunisation and administration of the first non-live vaccine was 64 days (interquartile range [IQR] 9-126 days). Deviation from standard vaccination sequence occurred in 33% of patients (7/21). At any one visit, 85% (18/21) were not given all eligible vaccines. 9% (2/22) were fully up-to-date with re-immunisations at the time of audit. Twenty patients were eligible for live vaccines. 65% (13/20) were given at least one dose of a measles-containing vaccine (MCV).
